All — quick draft language below that I think balances marketing and legal comfort. Feel free to copy into the order form.

Proposed publicity/reference clause (short):
"Customer grants Redwood Inference the right to identify Customer as a customer and to use Customer's name and logo in Redwood's marketing materials, including case studies and short testimonials of up to 120 characters, subject to Customer's prior written approval for any case study. Redwood agrees to provide Customer with a draft case study and a draft testimonial for approval. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Customer will have thirty (30) days from receipt to approve or request reasonable edits. If Customer does not respond within thirty (30) days, Customer's approval will be deemed granted.

For logo use, Customer will provide high-resolution assets and an executed brand usage confirmation (PDF) listing permitted variants, attributions, and trademark text. Redwood will use only approved assets and will comply with Customer's brand guidelines."

Clarifications/suggestions:
- Turn the "brand usage confirmation" into a one-page PDF that marketing signs; this is a low-friction ask (legal should be OK).
- For procurement records: we attach the confirmation PDF + a copy of the approved testimonial; that should satisfy their evidence requirement.
- If NovaCorp insists on no deemed-approval, legal will need to approve removing that clause.

I'll patch this into the redline and attach as "Nova_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf" (new). Also added an evidence checklist tab in redline_comments.xlsx.

Ben Carter
